standard.summary: relative（默认）：σ 按参数 RMS 缩放，零初始化 up 层早期几乎不加噪；absolute：全局固定 σ。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.relative: 按权重 RMS 相对加噪。

standard_en.summary: relative (the default): sigma is scaled by the parameter's RMS, so a zero-initialised up layer gets almost no noise early on; absolute: one fixed global sigma.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.relative: Noise added relative to the weight's RMS.
optionDescriptions.absolute: Noise added with a fixed sigma.

advanced.principle: relative（默认）：σ 按参数 RMS 缩放，零初始化 up 层早期几乎不加噪；absolute：全局固定 σ。

advanced_en.principle: relative (default): σ scales with each parameter's RMS, so zero-initialized up layers get almost no noise early on; absolute: one global fixed σ.
